Dear Saffron Studio team,

I have two years of professional experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js. At Tessellate Labs I built the React admin screens for refunds and credit notes and maintain the invoicing service, which issues about 9,000 invoices a month.

I am very comfortable with SQL. I cut our nightly reconciliation job from 41 minutes to 6 with set-based SQL and two partial indexes.

I have not used Next.js or Prisma; when nobody at work knew Docker Compose, I learned it in time for a two-week migration.

Could we have a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon
